resources.string: A quick snapshot of the latest AshShell updates powered by the new AshForge workflows and tooling.
Fresh capabilities that shipped with the latest AshForge drops:
What we are lining up next to keep AshShell fast and reliable:
• Integrate cross-platform session resume with AshForge sync primitives.
• Expand offline command cache with smarter diffing and verification.
• Ship progressive rollout tooling with real-time observability hooks.
